title: Implement a trie
statement: Implement Trie with insert(word), search(word) (exact word inserted?) and starts_with(prefix) (any inserted word with this prefix?). Lowercase letters.
hints: Each node: a map from character to child, plus an end-of-word flag.

solution.explanation: A tree of characters: insert walks and creates nodes, marking the last as a word end; search walks and checks the flag; starts_with only needs the walk to succeed. Every operation is O(length of the word), independent of how many words are stored.
